title: The Thirsty Loop
base_prompt: Hand-drawn stick-figure storybook illustration. Warm cream parchment background with soft paper grain. Thick, rounded, slightly uneven black ink lines. Stick figures have round white heads with two dot eyes, no nose, no mouth, simple limbs and plain flat-color robes. One accent color only: warm gold (#C8963E) for light, glory and sacred things. Flat shading, generous empty space, one clear focal subject per frame, simple ancient-world settings (desert, olive trees, stone houses, tents, hills, night sky). No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no photorealism, no 3D.

characters.Hero: colored stick figure, red shirt, blue pants, round white head, ink outline

scenes.vo: I just wanted a glass of water.
scenes.image_prompt: Stick figure slumped on a purple couch, thought bubble with a glass of water.

scenes.vo: So I went to the kitchen and opened the cabinet.
scenes.image_prompt: Walks into the teal kitchen, opens the cabinet.

scenes.vo: No clean cups, so I'll wash one.
scenes.image_prompt: Empty cabinet; bubble with a cup and a red X.

scenes.vo: And there's the sink, with every dish I own stacked in it.
scenes.image_prompt: The sink with a wobbling rainbow tower of dishes, no figure.

scenes.vo: I said I'd do these yesterday.
scenes.image_prompt: Scrubbing a plate; bubble with a calendar and a red X.

scenes.vo: Halfway through, my phone buzzes. Where did I put it?
scenes.image_prompt: Phone buzz; looks around; colorful question marks pop.
Looks down: the phone is in his hand; deadpan.

scenes.vo: One hour later. Dishes half done, phone dead, still no water.
scenes.image_prompt: Dark purple abstract: rainbow spiral around a racing clock; phone, plate, cup, question mark orbit; '1 hour later' note.

scenes.vo: If that's your brain too, one thing works for me. One song.
scenes.image_prompt: Pink headphones, bouncing to the beat; music notes rise; 'ONE song' note.

scenes.vo: I only have to finish one thing before it ends. One cup.
scenes.image_prompt: Washing one cup; water fills; green check; 'ONE cup' note.

scenes.vo: My head was never built to carry the whole house at once.
scenes.image_prompt: Calm on the couch; the scribble bubble floats away; golden window light.

scenes.vo: Isaiah 26:3 says, "Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
whose mind is stayed on thee."
One thing at a time. And He goes first.
scenes.image_prompt: Back on the couch with a full glass, smiling; closing notes; loops to the opening.
